high_level_description: The image shows a person sitting cross-legged on a wooden floor outdoors, surrounded by various potted plants. The individual is wearing a white t-shirt and light-colored pants, and they have headphones on. They appear to be engaged in an activity involving small seeds or grains, which are placed in a small terracotta pot in front of them. To the right of the pot, there is a light blue bowl containing more of the same seeds or grains. The setting appears to be a garden or a patio area with a brick wall in the background.
